summary: Nowinski, a nonpartisan candidate for at-large City Council in El Cerrito, runs on a platform of local budget, surveillance, and infrastructure issues. The single Palestine-related entry is a May 2024 statement in which Nowinski dismissed polls showing American support for a Gaza ceasefire as 'advocacy propaganda that always fall apart when you test the details,' framing public opinion favoring an end to the war as disinformation.
